ValidationRule.description: Only future date can be selected in next step date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Next_Step_Date__c)), Next_Step_Date__c < TODAY(),
OR( ISPICKVAL( Dealer_Account_Billing_Country__c, "United Kingdom" ),
ISPICKVAL( Dealer_Account_Billing_Country__c, "Ireland" ),
AND( ISPICKVAL( Dealer_Account_Billing_Country__c, "" ),
OR( Owner.Country = "United Kingdom", Owner.Country = "Ireland" ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Next Step Date Can Not Be In Past
